info.title: Country Details API Reference
info.description: Get comprehensive metadata for a specific country identified by its ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. Returns the country name, ISO codes (alpha-2, alpha-3, numeric), phone code, capital city, top-level domain, native name, region and subregion, nationality, flag emoji, and currency details (code, name, symbol). A valid two-letter country code is required. capital, region, and subregion are empty strings (not omitted) for the same handful of uninhabited/dependent territories as the Countries list endpoint — every other field, including currency and phone code, is populated for those territories.

get.summary: Retrieve comprehensive metadata for a specific country
get.description: Returns complete country details for a single country identified by its ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, including ISO codes, capital, currency, phone code, nationality, and flag emoji.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Format of the response. Possible values: json, xml.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country code in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format (e.g., US, PK).

unassignedFields.summary: Uninhabited territory — capital, region, and subregion are empty strings; every other field is still populated

400.description: Bad Request — Missing country parameter, or country is not a valid/known ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code

value.message: Only ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes country codes are supported.

ApiKeyAuthHeader.name: X-apiKey
ApiKeyAuthHeader.description: Pass your API key via the X-apiKey request header.

ApiKeyAuthQuery.name: apiKey
ApiKeyAuthQuery.description: Pass your API key via the apiKey query parameter.

CountryDetailsResponse.description: Comprehensive metadata for a single country resolved from an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.

name.description: The full English name of the country.

iso_alpha_2.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 two-letter country code.

iso_alpha_3.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code.

phone_code.description: The international dialing/phone code for the country.

capital.description: The capital city of the country. Empty string for uninhabited/dependent territories with no capital.

native_name.description: The name of the country in its native language.

region.description: The broad geographical region the country belongs to. Empty string for a small number of territories with no assigned region.

subregion.description: The more specific subregion the country belongs to. Empty string for a small number of territories with no assigned subregion.

nationality.description: The demonym for citizens of the country.

flag_emoji.description: The emoji flag representing the country.

currency_code.description: The ISO 4217 currency code used in the country.

currency_name.description: The full name of the currency used in the country.

currency_symbol.description: The symbol of the currency used in the country.

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error envelope returned by the API on failed requests.

error.description: Short error category or exception type.

message.description: Human-readable error message describing the failure.
